name: Roomba Combo j9+ (US)

radios.note: iRobot's Wi-Fi table lists the Combo j7+/j9+ on both 2.4 and 5 GHz.

matter.note: No Matter statement found on iRobot pages or a CSA listing.

apple_home.note: iRobot says the robot can pair with Siri; that is voice control, not a Home app accessory. Apple Home support not confirmed.

google_home.note: iRobot says the robot can be paired with Google Assistant.

alexa.note: iRobot says the robot can be paired with Alexa.

smartthings.note: No iRobot or Samsung page found for SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: The official Roomba integration page does not list the j9+ among tested models and says newer x05 Wi-Fi models do not work. j9+ support not confirmed.

hubRequired.note: The Clean Base Auto-Fill dock is not a hub.

localControl.note: No maker statement on local-only control found.

cleaning.note: Combo model that vacuums and mops.

suctionPa.note: iRobot's pages we saw do not state suction in pascals.

selfEmptying.note: Clean Base Auto-Fill dock empties debris for up to 60 days and refills liquid.

summary: iRobot's Roomba Combo j9+ vacuums and mops and comes with a dock that empties the bin and refills the tank. It pairs with Alexa, Google Assistant and Siri voice control. No Matter support was found.
